label: Buying a theatre in Branson with a fifteen hundred seat auditorium
description: A plan he says the Lord spoke to him and his wife about: moving part-time, buying a theatre in Branson and holding prayer meetings and healing services in a fifteen hundred seat auditorium, as a central American location a named healing evangelist could come to rather than the east coast and Florida. Unlike most of the corpus this is a claim about his own future actions, so it can be checked directly.

label: Three wells of revival across Cuba, in the west, the middle and the east
description: Three major wells of revival in Cuba, one in the far west, one in the middle and one toward the east, each a gusher of water said to be a fountain that will never run dry, with churches birthed around them. He tells the Miami pastor who says he already has the largest church in Cuba that he will have two more, which turns the image into a countable claim.

label: A witchcraft spirit over Cuba whose back is broken
description: A witchcraft spirit thick over the whole island, seen as a legless figure like gauze or the Grim Reaper stretching over Cuba, whose back the Lord says he is breaking, with the glory coming on the land as it departs like a storm parting. An old woman in a prayer shawl is seen travailing for the country. Nothing observable is attached to it, so it can only be scored through the revival claims it is paired with.

it looked like a parting of a storm

label: The number seven over Taiwan, scratched, with a shield of faith
description: The number seven seen big, bold and highlighted over Taiwan, trying to fade out, with stripes or scratches across it, alongside a shield with the word faith on it, seen after North Korea. He does not say what the seven counts, so years, months, days or a date are all open, which is what makes it unfalsifiable as given.

label: A doubling and acceleration in the six months from Passover
description: A doubling of where things were, running from Passover through the next six months, with an acceleration of events and a call to pray more. Passover 2026 began on 1 April, so the window closes at the start of October 2026. What doubles is not stated, which is what would have to be pinned down to score it.

label: Persecution moves next to England, then France, Germany and Italy
description: After Canada, the next phase of persecution comes to England and is stronger, over not being able to say certain things, then comes stronger still in France and tries to go through Germany and Italy. The order is stated, which makes it more checkable than the usual persecution material, though he says it will be resisted in prayer, which gives an exit either way.

label: A named Miami pastor takes a team of about a hundred into Cuba
description: A named Spanish-speaking pastor from Miami seen going to Cuba with a team of about a hundred people around him, holding revivals across the nation, with missionaries going in through a major window when the president liberates the island. Naming the man, the team size and the trigger makes this one of the more checkable revival claims.
